text: The MRI results are surprisingly normal, which contradicts the physical finding of a firm, fixed mass. text: The consistent finding of a well-circumscribed subcutaneous cystic lesion across multiple imaging modalities, despite the initial firm feel and negative biopsies, strongly points to a benign encapsulated mass that may have been sampled non-representatively or is a specific type of cyst resistant to standard aspiration. Given the location on the nape of the neck and the cystic nature, I am diagnosing this as a cervical epidermoid cyst. DIAGNOSIS READY: Cervical Epidermoid Cyst
